{{Quote|Ilum's no place for a war. Narrow passages, sharp jutting rocks and the coldest wind you ever felt.|Grand Moff Regus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Eastern Ice Shelf''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] that saw heavy fighting during the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was the site of the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Ilum Temple]], the [[Southern Sleetlands]], [[Fort Salvo]], and a number of crystal mines.
